root_cause: Production model uses NATIVE preprocessing + DSA-CP. Ring write is in PROLOG_V3 (fused preprocessing). These are DIFFERENT code paths and are incompatible.

error_detail.error: Fused preprocessing does not support DSA-CP

the_fundamental_issue.production_path: The production GLM-5.3 model uses AscendSFADSACPImpl with NATIVE preprocessing. This is the standard serving path.
the_fundamental_issue.hot128_ring_write: We placed the BF16 ring write inside PROLOG_V3 (RmsNormAndQuantizeCkv in the fused PROLOG kernel).
the_fundamental_issue.mismatch: PROLOG_V3 is NOT the selected path in production. The model uses NATIVE preprocessing instead.
the_fundamental_issue.consequence: Even if we fix all contract checks, the ring write will never execute because PROLOG_V3 is not called.

questions: 1. Is PROLOG_V3 ever used in production serving? Under what conditions is it selected vs NATIVE?
2. Can we switch the service to use PROLOG_V3 instead of NATIVE? What would break?
3. Or should the ring write be moved to the NATIVE preprocessing path instead?
4. What is the actual preprocessing path used by the mxllm-c4 reference deployment?
5. Is there a configuration option to force PROLOG_V3 selection?
additional_config_note: D node has enable_dsa_cp=false but still selects AscendSFADSACPImpl with NATIVE. P node has enable_dsa_cp=true. Both use NATIVE preprocessing. The enable_dsa_cp setting may not control the implementation selection as we assumed.
